other_conditions: Farmer must not be currently cultivating vegetables
Farmer must possess a forest rights certificate to be eligible
Grant is provided only once per farmer
Grant is payable for a minimum of 0.25 hectares and a maximum of 2.00 hectares
benefits_summary: The scheme provides a 50% subsidy on seed and planting material costs, up to ₹10,000 per hectare for seeds and up to ₹30,000 per hectare for planting material, whichever is less.
